VBO:0201229.summary: Affectionate and very energetic in his owner’s account, Cisco was a three-year-old German Shepherd–Border Collie cross whose pastimes included cuddles, swimming and fetch. His owner found training easy and described a gradual adjustment to household cats, which eventually slept beside him.
